chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny?' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is often interpreted as addressing both humans and jinn, but also symbolically representing the dual nature of creation or the two realms of the visible and invisible worlds. The verse serves as a rhetorical device to evoke gratitude by reminding the audience of the infinite, often overlooked, blessings of Allah, reinforcing the concept of *tawhid* through recognition of divine favors.
